results.query: What is the legal business name, doing-business-as (DBA) aliases, corporate website, and country of incorporation for an organization?
Which federal and commercial identifiers (UEI, CAGE code, DUNS number) are recorded for the organization, and which are missing?
What organization type, business category, and subcategory are recorded for the vendor?
What is the complete physical headquarters address (street line, city, state, ZIP+4, country, and congressional district) of the organization?
Does the organization have a corporate parent or ultimate parent entity, and what are the parent's legal name, UEI, and DUNS?
Is the organization foreign-owned, foreign-controlled, or flagged for Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI)?
What socioeconomic small-business certifications (Small Business, SDVOSB, VOSB, WOSB, EDWOSB, HUBZone, 8(a), SDB) are recorded for the organization?
Which organization records are candidate duplicates or sister subsidiaries based on shared CAGE, UEI, parent lineage, normalized name, or web domain?
What primary and secondary NAICS codes and descriptions are associated with the organization's federal contracting history?
What Product Service Codes (PSCs) characterize the goods and services delivered by the organization?
What is the organization's total all-time federal prime spending and its annual obligation trend by fiscal year (including FY25 and FY26)?
How many prime federal contract awards (total, active, and completed) does the organization hold, and what are its average and largest contract values?
Which federal agencies and sub-agencies are the organization's primary customers by award count and obligated dollars?
How many federal subawards and total subaward dollars has the organization received, and which Prime Contractors issued them?
What is the organization's Prime-to-Subaward ratio, and does it operate primarily as a prime integrator or a sub-tier supplier?
What percentage of the organization's prime awards were competed (Full & Open) versus non-competed / sole-source, and under what authorities?
What contract pricing structures (Firm Fixed Price, Time & Materials, Cost-Plus) dominate the organization's federal awards?
Which Indefinite Delivery Vehicles (IDVs/IDIQs), GWACs, or master ordering agreements does the organization hold or receive orders under?
What is the canonical name, model/version series, and offering type (Prototype, Product, COTS) of each technology capability?
At what system hierarchy level (Vulcan Q11: "My capability is:") does the technology operate?
What is the technical description and architectural composition of the capability offering?
What core technical differentiator distinguishes the capability's engineering design?
What unique competitive advantage over existing commercial or defense baselines is claimed for the solution (Vulcan Q8)?
How is the capability modeled under Basic Formal Ontology (BFO) upper-level categories?
Which European Defence Agency (EDA) OSRA Defence Technology Taxonomy Building Blocks (TBB) classify the capability?
Which active MEIA Topic Area(s) (meia.mil & Vulcan Q2) does the capability align to?
How do source taxonomy labels map across MEIA Topic Areas, EFDI Focus Areas, Vulcan labels, TMTR categories, ICF Mission Areas, and EDA OSRA schemes, and which terms remain UNMAPPED?
What warfighter operational problem and Joint Operational Problem (JOP) gap does the capability address (Vulcan Q1 & MEIA Charter)?
What specific, quantifiable operational capability contribution does the solution deliver (Vulcan Q3)?
What physical Size, Weight, Power, and Cooling (SWaP-C) and environmental ruggedization standards are specified in technical brochures?
What are the recorded Technology Readiness Level (TRL), Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL), and Integration Readiness Level (IRL) values for the capability, and which scales are missing?

What is the chronological readiness trajectory recorded for the capability (TRL 1 Date, Current TRL Date, Projected TRL 9 Date), and which Capabilities meet a specified minimum threshold (e.g., TRL >= 6)?
What is the vendor's qualitative self-assessment of technical maturity (Vulcan Q9)?
What performance measures and evaluation metrics are defined for assessing the capability (Vulcan Q7 & TMTR)?
What software/hardware integration architecture, open standards, and cryptographic provisioning mechanisms are supported (Vulcan Q10 & Brochures)?
How does the capability trace through the ICF & MEIA Mission Engineering spine (MissionArea → Scenario → DesiredEffect → Task → SystemFunction → System/Offering)?
What submission identifiers, Scoutcard URLs, first-submitted timestamps, and last-updated timestamps are recorded in the intake system?
What are the current Twenty CRM pipeline stage, assessment status, go/no-go decision, 48-hour callback timer state, and escalation level for a submission?
Who are the Primary and Secondary vendor Points of Contact (POC 1, POC 2), including full name, email, and phone number?
Which Government Sponsors, Technical Leads, Operational Users, Maintainers, and Collaborators (Sponsor 1, Technical 1, User 1, Maintainer 1, Collaborator 1) are recorded on a submission?
What is the vendor's One-on-One Meeting Security Preference (Vulcan Q12) for engaging with MEIA evaluators?
What funding tier is requested by the vendor to scale production (Vulcan Q5: Funding to Scale)?
What current unit cost and projected scaled unit cost are recorded for the offering (Vulcan Q6: Unit Cost)?
What production, scalability, or supply-chain constraints are disclosed by the vendor (Vulcan Q4)?
What Intellectual Property, data rights, or cooperative agreement terms (Product Rights) are asserted on the submission?
Is the submitted capability marked as Export Controlled (ITAR/EAR) in the intake record?
Through which intake program (MEIA vs. EFDI), source system (Vulcan, Twenty Portal, TMTR), and outreach event did the submission enter the portfolio?
What internal CRM engagement metadata (Assigned Account Manager, Lead Source, Lead Status, Last Contact Date, Next Follow-up Date, Profile Verified status) is recorded?
For an AAT TMTR intake record, what transition partner, schedule, cost, and four-dimensional risk ratings (Cost Risk, Schedule Risk, Performance Risk, Budget Risk) are recorded?
Which items in the Human Review Queue (candidate entity merges, unmapped taxonomy terms, low-confidence extracted claims) are awaiting Data Steward or SME disposition?
Which U.S. Small Business startups (Org-KG) offer technologies aligned to Counter C5ISR-T (Tech-KG) with a current TRL >= 6?
How do an organization's historical federal NAICS and PSC codes (Org-KG) align with the EDA OSRA Technology Building Blocks (Tech-KG) of its technical capabilities?
Which capabilities in the Technology Graph (Tech-KG) are backed by verified federal contract awards or government T&E purchases (Org-KG) versus brochure-only assertions?
Which organizations offering C5ISR, tactical networking, or edge compute capabilities (Tech-KG) carry Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) indicators (Org-KG)?
Which technologies originated in an SBIR/STTR R&D phase (Org-KG) and subsequently transitioned into sole-source operational contracts for tactical edge deployment (Tech-KG)?
Which vendors with high subaward-to-prime ratios (PrimeVsSubRatio < 0.30 in Org-KG) supply modular hardware components integrated into larger DoD programs (Tech-KG)?
Where do organization-level historical capabilities (Org-KG PSC/NAICS) and submitted technology topic alignments (Tech-KG) diverge or indicate expansion into a new domain?
For all submissions in the CRM (CRM-Graph), which submitting vendors have complete federal registration identifiers (UEI, CAGE, DUNS in Org-KG) and which have registration gaps?
How does a vendor's requested scaling funding in CRM (Q5 Funding to Scale in CRM-Graph) compare against its historical federal prime award volume (Org-KG)?
Which CRM submissions and portal contacts (CRM-Graph) link to the same resolved organization (Org-KG), and what matching signals justify the link?
Which submissions requesting classified one-on-one meetings (Q12 in CRM-Graph) involve organizations with socioeconomic preferences or FOCI governance requirements (Org-KG)?
Which government technical POCs or sponsors named on a CRM submission (CRM-Graph) belong to agencies that have previously contracted with or purchased from the vendor (Org-KG)?

Which capabilities in the CRM portfolio combine high technical/manufacturing readiness (TRL >= 6 and MRL >= 8 in Tech-KG) with government-favorable IP rights (Government Purpose Rights or CRADA in CRM-Graph)?

How do the unit cost and production rate projections (Q6 Unit Cost and Q4 Constraints in CRM-Graph) relate to the capability's Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) and COTS/material architecture (Tech-KG)?

Which capabilities that have completed live operational field experimentation (SONIC SPEAR 26, OASIS, or drone printability demos in Tech-KG) are candidates for Joint Acceleration Reserve (JAR) transition resourcing (CRM-Graph)?
Does the same canonical capability offering (Tech-KG) appear across multiple CRM submissions, programs (MEIA vs. EFDI), or intake versions (CRM-Graph)?

For a planned MEIA experimentation campaign targeting Contested Logistics (CRM-Graph Event), which submitted capabilities (Tech-KG) satisfy the topic alignment and can be briefed at an UNCLASSIFIED level (CRM-Graph Q12)?

Exact Evidence Locator & Provenance Trace: Which exact source file, source version, SHA-256 hash, spreadsheet cell (Sheet!Row:Col), PDF page/bounding box, or USASpending transaction ID supports a returned claim, and which ontology and graph versions were used?
Conflicting Evidence Preservation: When two sources or versions disagree on an organization's identifier, readiness level, or deployment status, how does the system respond?
Claim vs. Empirical Demonstration Non-Equivalence Gate: Has Vendor X's capability been verified in an AFSIM digital engineering simulation or live military exercise, or is it only a vendor assertion?

Minimum-Sufficient Routing & Module Capability Gate: What happens when a query requires exact PDF table/figure coordinates (Evidence Graph), or procurement history (Org-KG), in a deployment profile where that module is disabled?

Access Control, PII & Security Classification Gate: What happens when a caller without authorization requests encrypted PII contacts (POC Email/Phone), Export Controlled = Yes technical data, or TOP SECRET // SCI (4-Pack) / SECRET // REL FVEY meeting details?
Out-of-Scope & Unrecorded Fact Abstention Gate: What is Ghostfin's acoustic signature decibel rating at 30 knots, or what is KLAS Government's Vulcan Q5 funding request?
